title: FORGE Learning Entry
description: One JSON object per line in _index.jsonl. Captures a non-obvious insight from a completed FORGE task.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD when the learning was captured.

source_task_id.description: task_id from telemetry/sessions.jsonl if this learning derived from a specific session.

domain.description: Domain module name or free-form domain label.

keywords.description: Lowercase keywords distilled from the task. Used for grep-based retrieval matching.

normalized.description: category|domain|sorted-keywords joined for fast string matching.

what_worked.description: What specific approach, decision, or pattern produced the outcome. Be concrete.

what_failed.description: What was tried and discarded, what assumptions broke, or 'n/a' if nothing failed. Often the most valuable field.

generalization.description: When does this learning apply? What conditions change the answer? Future-you reads this to judge relevance.

applies_to.description: Free-form list of category:domain pairs or scope tags (e.g., 'CREATION:ai_tooling', 'any:windows-environment').

confidence.description: How confident are you this generalizes beyond the originating task? Use the FORGE Confidence Protocol scale.

source.description: How this learning was captured. telemetry-derived = mined from a sessions.jsonl entry; manual = added directly by the user; post-mortem = retrospective on completed work.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering and discovery.

deep_dive_path.description: Optional relative path to a companion .md file with richer context (e.g., 'learnings/2026-05-10-skill-vs-hook.md').
